answers: Review round 1 (review 5706303462): one High, three Medium and four Minor findings, each answered on its own thread and resolved; plus the defect the e2e run that settled under this round found
head: 368e3d2bbdff611006ec4dc00c2b4c9133c2bdb4

proof.criterion: Review round 1, High (worker.Dockerfile:439): in a worker pod every Go version query answered from the warm cache, so a role never saw a newer release
proof.surface: The Go toolchain a role runs (go1.27.1), with a scratch download cache filled as the image's `go` stage fills it and a fresh GOMODCACHE each time
proof.command: Two runs. The version query: `GOPROXY='file://<cache>/cache/download|https://proxy.golang.org|direct' go list -m -versions golang.org/x/text`, before and after deleting the cache's `@v/list` and `@latest` files. The offline read: the same proxy list with the public proxy replaced by `http://127.0.0.1:1`, then `go mod download golang.org/x/text` at the pinned version.
proof.observed: Before the deletion the query answered `golang.org/x/text v0.3.0` and nothing more, which is the defect. After it the same command ends `… v0.41.0 v0.42.0 v0.43.0`, fresh from proxy.golang.org. Offline, `go mod download` at the pinned version exits 0 with v0.3.0.info, .mod, .zip and .ziphash written into the fresh cache, so an exact version still comes from the image with no network. The `go` stage now deletes those files after its download and the final stage's own check fails the build when one is left.
proof.negativeControl: Offline, `go list -m golang.org/x/text@latest` with the same proxy list fails `dial tcp 127.0.0.1:1: connect: connection refused` rather than answering v0.3.0 from the image. That refusal is the fall-through working: with no list in the cache the file proxy answers 404 and the next source is asked, and when the next source is dead the command says so instead of lying.

proof.criterion: Review round 1, Medium (mirror-ci-images.sh:55): a row refreshed on a branch moved the shared tag, turning every other ci-images run red and leaving main's digest untagged
proof.surface: The copy and the gate, driven over fixtures by their own harnesses with a stand-in registry
proof.observed: `Results: 25 passed, 0 failed` and `Results: 89 passed, 0 failed`; the tree mode passes on the real tree. The copy reads `<the upstream repository>@<the row's digest>`, so it lands at that row's bytes whatever upstream has done since, and every row's tag now ends with the first eight hex characters of its own digest, which the gate refuses otherwise, naming the tag the row should carry. A shared tag is therefore impossible rather than discouraged. The post-copy refusal is re-worded: with a digest source it can no longer mean `correct the row's digest`.
proof.negativeControl: The copy's new case: the stand-in registry has moved the upstream tag to another digest, and the run still asks for `docker.io/oven/bun@<the row's digest>`, lands there and exits 0. The gate's new red case covers both tag shapes, a row whose upstream names a tag and one whose upstream names a digest alone.

proof.criterion: Review round 1, Medium (check-ci-images.sh:556): a Bun or Go bump had to change its row and its consumers in one commit, so those consumers raced the copy
proof.surface: The gate over fixtures and over the real tree, and the prose that tells a reader what to do
proof.observed: Rule 3 now refuses a tree where no row copies `oven/bun` at the `.bun-version` pin or no row copies `library/golang` at `ARG GO_VERSION`, and admits an extra row for another version, so a bump is two commits: the row, then the pin and the FROMs. check-bun-version.sh still refuses a FROM on a row of any other version, so nothing loosens. The two-commit order is in .github/ci-images.yaml's header, AGENTS.md's Tech Stack bullet and the solution document, whose two wrong sentences are corrected: `does not race its own gate` now says it is true of the package half alone and names the consumers that do race it, and the `do not re-run` step now says to read the failure against that run's own ci-images job first.
proof.negativeControl: Two red cases and one green: every bun row off the pin fails naming it; a golang pin no row carries fails; and a tree carrying a next-version row beside the pinned one passes, which is the case the old rule refused and the whole point of the change.

proof.criterion: Review round 1, Medium (stage1-skeleton.sh:153): the forward merge put that proof back on PostgreSQL 16, undoing main's #2498
proof.surface: The rows file and the script, with the digest read back from Docker Hub before it was written
proof.command: An anonymous Docker Hub manifest read of `docker.io/library/postgres@sha256:979bccfd…`, then `grep -n postgres .github/ci-images.yaml scripts/e2e/stage1-skeleton.sh`
proof.observed: Docker Hub answers that digest. The rows file holds one postgres row, `postgres-979bccfd`, and the script's one `docker run` names it; the `postgres-16` row is deleted, and the gate's tree mode passes, which proves nothing else named it. The row's comment says it is PostgreSQL 18, the major version CI's service and Cloud SQL run, and that CI gives the script a DSN so this pull happens on a devbox alone.
proof.negativeControl: The gate is the control that the old row is really gone and nothing dangles: rule 6 refuses a reference whose digest has no row, and the tree mode passes at this head with 12 rows and 35 references.

proof.criterion: The e2e workflow this issue adds: the five hosted proofs pass on a GitHub-hosted runner — and the defect the first settled run under this round found
proof.surface: GitHub Actions in sjawhar/legion, the `e2e` label on this pull request, read from each job's evidence artifact
proof.command: E2E proofs run 40966595125 at 4d8ae1f7, then run 40979438094 at 368e3d2b
proof.observed: 40966595125 settled: `select`, `child-adoption`, `dispatch-claimant-delivery`, `no-required-checks` and `stage1-skeleton` passed, and `merged-root-waits` failed. Its evidence artifact names a defect older than this pull request: its live test builds `fake.NewRuntime()` without `InPod`, so the daemon takes the tmux answer and tries `jj git clone https://github.com/acme/widgets`, a repository that does not exist, and the architect it waits for never launches (`timed out waiting for the launch of …-architect`; the daemon log shows three launch failures on that clone). Its two sibling proofs set `rt.InPod = true` and pass. One line and the comment its siblings carry, in 368e3d2b. Run 40979438094 is that head's run and had not settled at completion.
proof.negativeControl: `go vet -tags e2e ./internal/daemon/` passes at this head. The run itself was the control for the workflow: four proofs green and one red, each reporting its own cause with its own artifact, which is how the defect was read. No machine could have passed that proof as it stood, which is why only a run found it.

filesChanged: packages/daemon/docker/worker.Dockerfile: the go stage deletes every @v/list and @latest from the cache it ships, and the final stage's check fails the build if one is left
.github/ci-images.yaml: one tag per digest, a PostgreSQL 18 row in place of the 16 one, and a header that states the two-commit bump
.github/scripts/mirror-ci-images.sh and its harness: the copy reads the row's digest, with a case where the upstream tag has moved
.github/scripts/check-ci-images.sh and its harness: the tag rule, rule 3's rewrite, the both-suffixes loop deleted, workflow_paths.walk imported, one exception dropped
.github/scripts/check-bun-version.sh and its harness: the ARG rule applies to a Dockerfile that reads the ARG, and the fixtures name docker.io
packages/envoy/docker/Dockerfile: the dead ARG BUN_VERSION deleted
packages/daemon/internal/daemon/merged_root_waits_live_test.go: the pod runtime its two sibling proofs use
AGENTS.md, docs/kubernetes.md, docs/solutions/github/an-image-pull-that-fails-in-ci-…-INFRA-567.md: the prose each change falsified
deviations: The High finding is answered by deleting the cache's version lists rather than by seeding a pod's GOMODCACHE from the image on first start, which the architect recommended and left open: the proxy form needs nothing outside the image, where seeding would change how a pod starts a role. The architect's condition for keeping it is met and recorded — @latest fresh and an exact version offline, both as runs.

packages/daemon/internal/daemon/merged_root_waits_live_test.go is a file this pull request did not touch before this round. It is fixed here because it is a clear defect in code this change's own deliverable runs, and leaving it would ship a nightly that is red for a reason this change did not cause.
openQuestions: E2E proofs run 40979438094 at 368e3d2b, which carries the merged-root-waits fix, had not settled at completion. The run before it is the evidence that the other four pass and that a failure reports its cause with its artifact.
Docs (main) run 40946334589 on scratch pull request #2520 is still pending in the `pages` concurrency group, where main's own runs are pending. #2520 stays open until it settles.
discoveredComplexity: A live proof that no machine runs is a proof nobody has checked: merged-root-waits could not have passed anywhere, because the repository it makes its daemon clone does not exist, and it took the first hosted run of it to find that.
